tasks.task: Confirm and connect the vault folder
Hand-write 3–5 sample notes across a few different pilot projects or clients
Build one Bases view over the sample notes, showing date and description columns
Confirm the view answers real lookup questions; adjust schema if not
Decide what counts as "key information" for an image (D-006)
Set up the Inbox convention (folder or note), capturing project name and a short description at intake
Draft and finalize the rule table for known Drive/Canva locations, per company and project
Test Canva connector text extraction on one real client design (D-008)
Run the pipeline manually end-to-end on one source per format
Review and correct AI-inferred categorizations from the trial run
Turn the pipeline into a repeatable checklist or prompt
Build the rule table as an editable config file
Set up a Cowork scheduled task fired on demand (optional)
Evaluate whether volume justifies a standalone script
Build standalone script calling Google/Canva/Claude APIs directly (only if triggered)
Add a Sources view to the nova-tracker website (project, description, date, format)

tests.validates: Every field captures what's actually needed
Views return the right notes when filtered/grouped
One real source per format runs without manual fixes
Rule + AI-fallback calls correct on 10 sample sources
Re-submitting a source updates, not duplicates, the note
